summary: Phase 1 Inventory audit at feeca3f3. HEAD equals the audited SHA. The diff db2053f2..feeca3f3 touches only the five phase-owned paths (checker, red and green logs, plan.md evidence lines, scenes/inventory.md). All 30 inventory rows were verified word for word against the MAPS array in docs/map-review.html: 0 mismatches on rating, note, and all five path cells; the four empty source notes read none recorded; spot rows agree with bench/sonnet/log.tsv. Every plan evidence claim re-verified against actual command output: the gate checker exits 0 with 9/9 PASS, the plan gate prints 30, the TSV and docs/map-review.html are unchanged in the range, and all 30 briefs exist. The stop rule is read as one independent rating, one rework, one rerate, three ratings maximum, and F8 stays routed to the orchestrator as a spec-wording item. Two nonblocking checker-depth gaps remain: P1-c tests field presence only, so a wrong MAPS rating or fabricated note passes (fixture proof), and the P1-d absent-source branch is a substring test that a note containing the word missing can satisfy.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Nit] review-a check-inventory.sh P1-c (measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/check-inventory.sh:80-99): The P1-c check tests only that each row holds the literal labels MAPS rating:, judge: no, and maker:, not that the rating and note values agree with bench/sonnet/log.tsv or docs/map-review.html, and not the maker family value. Fixture proof: an inventory copy with the apothecary row changed to MAPS rating: 9.9 and MAPS note: totally fabricated passes the checker 9/9 with exit 0. Rationale: test-strategy.md section 5 P1-c claims each row records the MAPS rating and note from bench/sonnet/log.tsv, but a wrong inventory passes the phase gate and the closeout rerun; the committed inventory is faithful (verified this review), so the exposure is a future drift that the gate cannot catch, and the MAPS rating feeds the stop-rule count in section 2.

F2 [Nit] review-a check-inventory.sh P1-d (measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/check-inventory.sh:110-114): The absent-source branch tests the substring missing anywhere in the row line, not the state cell. A row whose MAPS note contains the word missing would satisfy the branch with state inventoried; the committed inn row note is missing hanging lantern. Rationale: latent only, because all 30 sources exist in Phase 1; the second P1-d loop already parses the state cell exactly, so the absent-source branch should reuse that parse when a source is ever absent.
